bench: Two engine attempts. a02 (fixed 25-generation rungs, the preregistered design): POSITIVE_CONTROL_FAILED -- rung 0 was climbed within its 25 generations in 5/12 seeds (the table's W0 class REACHABLE ~0.5 at G30 was read as 'reached within a rung'; it is not), so the ladder moved on before there was anything to carry in 7/12 seeds (L3-008). The machine change (ladder.rung0_max: HOLD rung 0 until the elite's best training reward reaches 0.5 or a cap of 100 generations, then the fixed schedule; probe plan re-anchored at the release; rows carry hold_gens / ladder_start / transitions / gens_run so every timing is relative to the release) was made before a re-preregistered attempt a05 (a03/a04 dry). a05: 233 s wall for 12 seeds x (hold + 100) generations (12-97 generations of hold, all released by competence, none by the cap), 1 world, 12 records, 12 reachability rows (W0, treated), 12 corridor ladder rows, 0 errors. The machine disposition (WEAK_POSITIVE) is the descriptive primary's artefact: treatment == control by design, so the effect is 0 >= 0 and no battery was declared; the record's disposition is set from the preregistered falsification and reading rules below. Bench notes: (1) per-seed wall 30-228 s -- the hold length and the elite's instruction count (8-27) drive it; (2) revisit cost 150 episodes per run (10% of 75 x 16 rung-1..3 batteries), the same in every seed; (3) the a02 fixed-schedule rows stay under their own prereg digest in the engine and in attempts/a02.
disposition_note: Preregistered falsification (general_heldout in < 4/12) NOT met: 11/12 seeds are delay-general with held-out 1.0 on all four rungs and all 11 survive to the end. Preregistered 'ladder is moot' reading (generality at the same probe as rung-0 competence in >= half of the general seeds) NOT met: 1/11. WEAK, not SUPPORTED, because no falsification battery was declared and the direct-search comparator (W1_d4 RARE 1/14) was measured at G60, not at this run's 112-197 generations; C3-SFE-04 runs direct W1_d4 at the matched budget.
landscape: The corridor W0 -> W1_d4 exists and is short. Given a W0-competent population (hold 12-97 generations, median 33), delay generality (>= 0.75 on delays 0/1/2/4, held-out 1.0) appears in 11/12 seeds, at rung 1 in 7, rung 2 in 3, rung 0 in 1; 10-50 generations after the release (median 35), i.e. within 25 generations of the first delay-1 battery in 9/11. Abrupt: R3 competence goes from < 0.25 to >= 0.75 between consecutive probes in 8/11 seeds (rise 0), 5-10 generations in 3. Adaptation cost is paid ONCE: adapt R1 = 0 in 6/11 seeds and 2-15 in 5; adapt R2 = adapt R3 = 0 in 11/11 -- once delay 1 is solved, delays 2 and 4 are solved on entry. At the first delay-1 battery the newly selected elite was already delay-1 competent (R1 0.0 -> 1.0 or 0.83 between the probe before and the probe at the transition) in 5/12 seeds: the W0 population CONTAINED delay-general organisms that W0 selection did not rank first; in 6/12 the delay-1 competence had to be built (2-15 generations). R0 forgetting: the elite fell below 0.25 on R0 in 5/12 seeds after a transition and recovered within 1-5 generations in 5/5 (p = 0.1 revisit); the one non-general seed (10) kept R0 = 1.0 and never got R1 above 0.19. Genotypes: 8-27 instructions, persist 'regs' in 9/12, 'all' in 3/12.
science: Assay capable on the second design: 12/12 seeds climbed rung 0 within the hold (12-97 generations, all by competence), so the corridor question was posed from a climbable base. RESULT: the delay ladder is a reliable corridor into W1_d4 at this budget: delay-general elites (>= 0.75 on delays 0/1/2/4 at the probes, confirmed 1.0/1.0/1.0/1.0 on 48 held-out episodes per rung) in 11 of 12 seeds, all surviving to the end (general_survives 11/11), vs direct W1_d4 search RARE (1/14 at G60; the matched-budget direct comparator is C3-SFE-04's job). WHERE the generality is minted: at the delay-1 rung in 7/11 (rung 0 in 1, rung 2 in 3), 10-50 generations after the release (median 35; the R1 transition is at +25). HOW it appears: abruptly (R3 rise 0 probes in 8/11) and only once -- the adaptation to delays 2 and 4 costs 0 generations in 11/11 seeds after delay 1 is solved (a delay-1 solution is delay-invariant; C2-SFE-06's 'delay-invariant on arrival' at n=3 replicates at n=11). WHO carries it: in 5/12 seeds the first delay-1 battery promoted an organism that was ALREADY delay-general (elite R1 0.0 at the probe before the transition, 1.0/0.83 at the transition) -- the W0 population held delay-general variants that W0 selection did not rank first, so part of the corridor's work is selection among existing variation, not construction; in 6/12 construction took 2-15 generations. SAME CORRIDOR? All 11 general elites share the route (W0 competence -> delay-1 competence -> free delays 2/4) but not the genotype: 8-27 instructions, persist 'regs' 9/12. Kill condition not triggered (positive control 12/12; arrival 11/12 vs 1/14). Must NOT be claimed: that the ladder beats direct search at equal budget (unmeasured until C3-SFE-04); that the rungs d2/d4 do anything (they add no adaptation: the corridor is W0 -> d1); mechanism (why delay-1 solutions are delay-invariant is a genotype question, not measured here).
